subject: Visibility gap for prefetch/KV cache — Greenwave POC impact
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-09T21:02:00Z
Subject: Visibility gap for prefetch/KV cache — Greenwave POC impact

Team —

Quick context: Greenwave (POC, deal GW-4231) reported intermittent stalls and degraded tail latency during a small set of production-ish runs this morning. They saw repeated prefix re-generation (duplicated tokens) and a build-up of queued requests that clear only after ~30s. Their infra team provided the attached trace and a CSV of prefetch timings.

What I know so far:
- Issue only shows up when prefetch is enabled and the model variant is the heavier quantization profile.
- Customer is on Dedicated pool in us-west.
- They observed request-level spikes that correlate with a series of near-identical prompts (prefix-heavy).

Ask: can Platform/Runtime help triage whether this is a visibility/kv-cache eviction problem (prefetch window vs. active kv entries) or something at the batching layer? Specifically:
1) What telemetry would we need from runtime to confirm kv/prefetch mismatches?
2) Any quick mitigation we can offer the customer (config change or workaround) while we investigate?
3) If this is a product gap (metrics/API surface), what would be the minimal roadmap ask to avoid repeated POCs failing?

I suggest a short sync (30m) tomorrow morning; flagged priority due to close-to-production usage.

Attachments: greenwave_prefetch_trace.json, prefetch-timings.csv

Thanks —
Mina
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-09T22:10:00Z
Subject: Re: Visibility gap for prefetch/KV cache — Greenwave POC impact

Thanks Mina — I dug into the attached trace quickly. A few clarifying questions first:
- Can you confirm whether prefetch is configured as "aggressive" (prefetch window > 6 tokens) or the default of 2? The CSV looks like multiple overlapping prefetch windows.
- Are they using streaming or non-streaming endpoints for these calls? The trace looks like the streaming path is used.

Initial hypothesis: this looks like a KV cache coherence + prefetch timing mismatch. In stressed sequences where many near-identical prefixes arrive, prefetch may be inserting entries that the next request expects but the eviction policy kicks in (or the shared cache is scoped per-session incorrectly). That can cause token re-generation and queued work while we recompute prefixes.

To triage:
- We need per-request KV hit/miss logs (attach request id) and prefetch start/complete timestamps. The trace includes some request ids but not the detailed KV events.
- Enable the runtime debug flags: runtime.kv.log_prefetch=true and runtime.batch.log_kv_hits=true for the customer's pool for a short window (5-10 minutes) and collect logs.

Quick mitigations to offer customer:
- Disable prefetch for the affected model variant (config toggle) — lowest-risk and quick.
- Pin a lighter quant profile (downgrade variant) temporarily for the POC to reduce cache pressure.

If this becomes recurring across accounts we should expose two telemetry points: prefetch_window (config) and kv_cache_hit_rate by route. Right now those are internal-only.

Happy to pair on the sync tomorrow.
—Karthik

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-10T02:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Visibility gap for prefetch/KV cache — Greenwave POC impact

Echo Karthik — prioritizing this. A couple product/ops notes:

1) Roadmap ask (short): Add route-level telemetry for kv_cache_hit_rate and a runtime-exposed gauge for prefetch_window. Minimal implementation: metric + tag by route/model-variant. This will unblock sales eng and support with empirical data for POCs.
2) Ops playbook (immediate): allow per-customer override to disable prefetch without a full rollout (toggle via Console + API). We have an internal ticket (SUP-9876) and I will add acceptance criteria.
3) Field messaging: please do the short mitigation first (disable prefetch or pin variant). Sales should tell Greenwave we will run a 48h extended trace with debug flags and share findings.

Logan — can you weigh in on whether exposing these metrics is an API/Console-only change or if it requires a runtime-side instrument + config change? I want to capture effort for the next sprint.

Related links: JIRA SUP-9876 (I'll create a subtask for the metric), Drive trace folder, tentative DocuSign for contract exec.

Marissa
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@greenwavehealth.com>, Greenwave Health Infra <infra@greenwavehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodhealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-10T13:47:00Z
Subject: Re: Visibility gap for prefetch/KV cache — Greenwave POC impact

Sophie / Greenwave infra — thanks for the quick trace. Internal summary and next steps below.

Summary (internal): suspected KV cache coherence / prefetch timing mismatch causing token duplication and transient queues when many similar prefixes arrive. Karthik recommended enabling runtime debug flags and/or disabling prefetch as a short-term mitigation. Marissa flagged a small product ask to expose prefetch_window and kv_cache_hit_rate as metrics for route-level visibility.

Immediate plan (what we'll do in the next 48 hours):
- Step 1 (Customer safe mitigation, <1 hour): We will disable prefetch for your dedicated pool and run a small exercise. This is reversible and low-risk.
- Step 2 (Debug window, next 24h): With your sign-off we'll enable runtime debug flags (prefetch + kv hit logs) for a 2-hour window and collect logs. Karthik will lead analysis.
- Step 3 (Follow-up, 48h): We share findings and a recommendation (pin variant, widen cache, or runtime fix).

Sophie — can you confirm a 30-min window tomorrow (May 11) between 09:00-12:00 PT for the debug run? If yes we'll schedule and send an invite.

Attachments: greenwave_prefetch_trace.json, prefetch-timings.csv

Thanks —
Mina
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com
